title: Spectral Choir
description: Multiple ghostly, semi-transparent figures with glowing eyes and open mouths appear to sing or emit swirling streams of white and gold smoke. The dark figures are arranged against a background of horizontal black stripes interspersed with deep red and blue paint strokes and gold flecks.
prompt: A surreal dark painting featuring multiple translucent ghostly figures with glowing eyes and open mouths emitting streams of white and golden swirling smoke. The figures are layered over a background of thick horizontal black stripes with splatters of deep red and blue, accented with gold flecks. Moody, atmospheric, painterly brushwork, dark fantasy aesthetic.
